outcome: Noonan-like syndrome with loose anagen hair
cohort: A neonate referred due to cystic hygroma and dysmorphic facial features, along with four additional male relatives who exhibited nystagmus.
finding: A pathogenic c.4A>G (p.Ser2Gly) variant in the SHOC2 gene, associated with Noonan-like syndrome with loose anagen hair, was identified in the neonate, with no other pathogenic variants for familial nystagmus found in affected relatives.
